_note: Measured from src/svg/logo-display.svg: ratio = height/width of the viewBox; line2 = ink width of AI CLUB / DARTMOUTH; line1_bottom = bottom of the DARTMOUTH ink / height. The build checks ratio against the SVG; measure line2 again by hand if the logo changes. The lockup: TeX Gyre Heros Bold, kerned, tracking -0.045 em, baseline to baseline 0.81 em (the gap between the lines is about 8% of the letter height). It is the one drawing of the logo: the giant home title and the header logo are the same SVG at different sizes, so the hand-off ends on exactly what it started as.
